title: Audit event (C8)
description: One JSON object per line on a dedicated logger/appender shipped to the SIEM. Never contains argument values, tool results, secrets or confirmation codes; additionalProperties is false so such fields cannot be added by accident. Target system of broker events is carried in 'server' (mcp-<system>). The serializer must escape control characters, U+2028 and U+2029 in every string value.

clientRequestId.description: X-Request-Id sent by the AI client, recorded by the gateway only (C3). Untrusted, so limited to a log-safe alphabet (CC-031); the gateway drops a value that does not match instead of rejecting the call.

id.description: Resource id as the system knows it (Jira key, GitLab path, index name, page id). Free-form because ids of the five systems use different alphabets (slashes, dots, spaces in some service desks), but C0 and C1 control characters, DEL, U+2028 and U+2029 are excluded so the line-oriented SIEM format cannot be broken (CC-031). Independently of this, the audit JSON serializer must escape every control character and U+2028/U+2029.

parent.description: Parent as <Namespace>::<Type>::<id>, e.g. Jira::Project::ABC (C8 example format).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, snake case. Known values: policy_forbid, not_granted, tool_disabled, user_confirmed, user_declined, confirmation_expired, credential_required, step_up_required, rate_limited.

argsLength.description: Length in bytes of the serialized arguments; the only trace of arguments allowed in audit.
